units.source_text: 第二年春天的，某一个夜里。

en.t: It was one night in the spring of the following year.

units.source_text: 那位日本的年轻旅行家第二次来看望宋金花。

en.t: The young Japanese traveler came to visit Song Jinhua for the second time.

units.source_text: 在昏暗的油灯下，他坐在她的对面。

en.t: Under the dim oil lamp, he sat facing her.
